title: New N5 test helper form_session_text string-interpolates the token into SQL (models an unsafe pattern)
detail: Test-only, the token is test-controlled, and it follows this file's pre-existing idiom (text_column/result_field/audit_event_for/focus_seconds_reported all interpolate the same way) — so no real injection and not a regression rc3-7 introduced. Flagged because the new helper models string-interpolated SQL rather than pog.parameter binding.
recommended_fix: Bind the token: pog.query("... WHERE form_token = $1") |> pog.parameter(pog.text(token)). Low priority — only if the file's query helpers are being migrated to bound params wholesale.
